subject: mathematics
concept: Writing numbers 1-20 in correct number order
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student places virtual numbered tiles onto a track in the correct order
exercise.pictorial: Student fills in missing numbers on a pictured number path
